needsNewNodes.name: Exact whole-number quotients within basic division facts
needsNewNodes.description: At Grade 2 level, compute exact whole-number quotients with a positive one-digit divisor and a one-digit quotient using any valid elementary strategy. Interpret the quotient as the group size in a supplied equal-sharing context.
needsNewNodes.reason: cnm_p043 covers division meaning, cnm_p046 prescribes multiplication facts, and cnm_p083 covers written division from higher place values in Grade 3. None supplies the route-neutral calculation target required here.

limitations: The proposed calculation target has no catalog ID, so assessedIds and method nodeIds remain empty.
The supplied explanation is AI-generated and not teacher reviewed; its English translation is machine-generated and not human reviewed.
candidate.changeReason: The check \(3\times6=18\) confirms the quotient, and the current equation is sufficient. Preserve it exactly; correct only the annotations that imposed a multiplication-fact route.
